verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or portability feature for Paperspace: no export of machines, snapshots, templates, or notebooks in open formats, and no account-wide data takeout. Root SSH access, which would let users copy files off a VM themselves, and 'Cancel anytime' are adjacent behaviors or user-side workarounds rather than an export capability. Snapshots and custom templates are documented only for reuse inside Paperspace.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
